rules.name: cash-refresh-14-phi-future-netting-provenance-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trade_id, parent_trade_id, subportfolio, contract_number, transaction_date, security_id, original_lots, active_lots, netting_date, netting_status, netted_lots, netting_id, trade_source, trade_category, trader_name, deal_status FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs WHERE trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-802053','TR-FY-2026-802055','TR-FY-2026-813084','TR-FY-2026-813196','TR-FY-2026-815920','TR-FY-2026-815921', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802053','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802055','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813084', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813196','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815920','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815921') ORDER BY trade_id

SELECT netting_date, netting_id, trade_id, security_id, group_type, subportfolio, contract_number, derivative_type, netting_status, netted_lots, active_lots FROM dbsystemuat.netting_id_table_cfs WHERE trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-802053','TR-FY-2026-802055','TR-FY-2026-813084','TR-FY-2026-813196','TR-FY-2026-815920','TR-FY-2026-815921', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802053','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802055','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813084', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813196','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815920','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815921') ORDER BY trade_id

SELECT netting_date, netting_id, count(*) AS trades, sum(netted_lots) AS netted_lots FROM dbsystemuat.netting_id_table_cfs WHERE netting_date = :valueDate AND security_id = :securityId GROUP BY netting_date, netting_id ORDER BY netting_id

SELECT trade_id, parent_trade_id, subportfolio, contract_number, transaction_date, security_id, original_lots, active_lots, netting_date, netting_status, netted_lots, netting_id, is_latest_version, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-802053','TR-FY-2026-802055','TR-FY-2026-813084','TR-FY-2026-813196','TR-FY-2026-815920','TR-FY-2026-815921', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802053','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802055','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813084', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813196','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815920','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815921') ORDER BY trade_id

SELECT netting_date, netting_id, trade_id, security_id, netting_status, netted_lots, active_lots, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.netting_id_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-802053','TR-FY-2026-802055','TR-FY-2026-813084','TR-FY-2026-813196','TR-FY-2026-815920','TR-FY-2026-815921', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802053','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802055','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813084', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813196','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815920','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815921') ORDER BY trade_id

SELECT netting_date, netting_id, trade_id, security_id, netting_status, netted_lots, active_lots, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.netting_history_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-802053','TR-FY-2026-802055','TR-FY-2026-813084','TR-FY-2026-813196','TR-FY-2026-815920','TR-FY-2026-815921', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802053','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802055','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813084', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813196','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815920','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815921') ORDER BY created_timestamp, trade_id

SELECT netting_date, netting_id, trade_id, security_id, netting_status, netted_lots, active_lots, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.cancelled_netting_history_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-802053','TR-FY-2026-802055','TR-FY-2026-813084','TR-FY-2026-813196','TR-FY-2026-815920','TR-FY-2026-815921', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802053','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802055','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813084', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813196','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815920','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815921') ORDER BY created_timestamp, trade_id

SELECT netting_date, netting_id, created_by, min(created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(created_timestamp) AS last_created, count(*) AS trades, sum(netted_lots) AS netted_lots FROM opera.netting_history_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND netting_date = :valueDate AND security_id = :securityId GROUP BY netting_date, netting_id, created_by ORDER BY first_created

SELECT trade_id, parent_trade_id, subportfolio, contract_number, transaction_date, security_id, original_lots, active_lots, netting_date, netting_status, netted_lots, netting_id, is_latest_version, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-802053','TR-FY-2026-802055','TR-FY-2026-813084','TR-FY-2026-813196','TR-FY-2026-815920','TR-FY-2026-815921', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802053','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-802055','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813084', 'NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-813196','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815920','NET-15251-7849-TR-FY-2026-815921') ORDER BY trade_id
